faults.title: Water pump failure and overheating (1.2T and Mk1)
faults.description: Auto Express says the Mk1 Mokka could suffer water pump failure leading to overheating that can kill the engine, and the 1.2T petrol in the 2021-on Mk2 can still have this fault.

faults.title: Early wear on dampers and ball joints (Mk2)
faults.description: Mk2 dampers and ball joints can fail early. Auto Express suggests an MoT-style check, and notes many Mk2s were hire cars, so look for abuse such as slipping clutches.

faults.title: Mokka-e locking problems (Mk2)
faults.description: The electric Mokka-e's locking can play up because of a tired key fob or 12V battery, a software glitch or a blown fuse.

faults.title: Weak handbrake and hesitant 1.4T (Mk1)
faults.description: Some Mk1 owners found the handbrake didn't hold the car securely on steep slopes, and a software issue can make the 1.4T in the Mokka X hesitate when pulling away.

faults.title: Mk2 suspension and fuel leak recalls
faults.description: The Mk2 has had eight recalls, including loose suspension parts, wipers that might not work, fuel leaks, emissions issues and two Mokka-e software campaigns.
